messages:
Tara: Quick thread  proposing a compact left rail that groups by journey (Author > Deploy > Monitor). Mock attached. Major asks: permalink stability, breadcrumb verbosity, and screen-reader announcements. Thoughts?

Evan: Nice direction. Permalinks must be stable. Keep canonical resource paths like `/console/models/:id`. UI cluster state should map to a query param, e.g., `?cluster=deploy`.

Ming: Agree. Also we should support fragment anchors for intra-page links: `#panel=metrics`. On load map the hash to router state with `history.replaceState` so back-button isn't spammed.

Priya: Accessibility: add `aria-expanded` on group toggles, `aria-controls` to link toggles to panels, and `aria-current=\"true\"` on the active rail item. When cluster changes announce \"Switched to Deploy\" via a polite live region and move focus to the first interactive element.

NavBot: /audit left-rail -> Findings: missing `aria-expanded` on 2 toggles; no live region detected for cluster changes. Recommend adding `role=region` + `aria-live=polite` on cluster content.

Tara: Breadcrumb update: current \"Models / 314\". Proposal: \"Models  ImageGen v1.2 (314)\" to show model+version. Truncate at 40 chars with middle ellipsis; show full title on hover / long-press. Mobile: use compact title like \"ImageGen v1.2\".

Evan: For analytics, normalize events to emit a synthetic path for reporting, e.g., `/console/models/:id/cluster/deploy` so dashboards aren't fragmented by query variants. Also preserve utm/ref query params across redirects.

Ming: Pseudocode for hash handling:

```
// on page load
const hash = window.location.hash;
if (hash.startsWith('#panel=')) {
  const panel = decodeURIComponent(hash.split('=')[1]);
  router.replace({ pathname: location.pathname, query: { ...router.query, panel } }, undefined, { shallow: true });
  focusPanel(panel); // move focus + announce
}
```

Use `replace` to avoid pushState spam. Add tests for back-button behavior.

Priya: When focusing panels programmatically call `announceForAccessibility('Panel: ' + panelLabel)` and ensure each panel has `role=\"region\"` and `aria-labelledby`. Clear the live region after announcement to avoid repeated reads.

Tara: Action items: 1) Routing shim + redirect notes (Evan)  include analytics mapping and utm preservation; 2) Add ARIA attrs, live region, and axe run (Priya); 3) Breadcrumb copy spec + truncation examples (Ming). Sync Fri 10:00.

Evan: I'll draft the routing adapter and a small migration doc with redirect examples. Will include tests ensuring legacy links still resolve and utm params persist. ETA Wed EOD.

Ming: I'll write the breadcrumb guideline (max 40 chars, middle truncation, tooltip = full slug) and attach updated mocks + mobile variants.

Priya: I'll add aria attributes and run `axe-core` across nav permutations. Will paste results here and include a tiny Playwright E2E for keyboard focus and screen-reader announcements.

Tara: Thanks all  Loom with mock: https://loom.com/share/compact-rail-demo (90s). NavBot: please remind before sync. :calendar:

NavBot: Reminder scheduled: Fri 10:00am. Calendar invite sent to participants.
